title: Exterior Painting in Hawthorne, FL | Siding & Trim
description: Exterior painting in Hawthorne, FL for lake humidity and summer storms: mildew treatment, rot repair, acrylic or elastomeric coatings, and a written warranty.
heroIntro: Shaded lake-facing walls that grow mildew and sun-blasted west walls that fade are the two sides of every Hawthorne exterior. Our crews treat those two problems as separate jobs on the same house, wall by wall.

sections.h2: Every elevation tells a different story
body: Walk around most houses near Lochloosa or Johnson Lake and the walls look like they belong to four different buildings. The north side, or any wall under heavy tree cover, stays damp and turns green. The south and west sides chalk and lose color. Fascia boards peel along the bottom edge where rain sheets off the roof. Exterior painting in Hawthorne, FL has to solve every one of those problems on a single house, which is why the crew lead shoots photos of each side of your home and gives each its own notes in the quote. That habit comes from years of working around Hawthorne's lakes.

bullets: Clean the lake-side grime with a soft wash or pressure rinse, killing mildew in the same pass
Knock off flaking film and sand the ridges smooth so old edges vanish
Meter any wood that looks damp, and swap out decayed fascia or trim
Fresh caulk in open seams, nail pops reset, primer dabbed on bare patches
Mask glass, fixtures, hardware, drives, and plantings
body: Peeling on lake-area homes is almost always about moisture getting behind the film. If you want the science, we explain it in a post on why muggy air makes paint peel.

On Hawthorne siding and trim we apply a 100% acrylic from the premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore catalogs; it stretches through hot afternoons and breathes so damp from the lake air can escape. Stucco that is moving at hairline cracks takes a thicker elastomeric able to span those gaps. Entry doors and porch rails are finished in a waterborne urethane enamel. Two complete coats go on every wall, a third if the substrate soaks paint up or the new color is a big departure, and anything sprayed is worked in afterward with a brush or roller where the coating has to penetrate.
The newer homes along SR-20 often need less carpentry but benefit from the same film build, since their original coats were thin.

Color choice also affects lifespan. Deep, saturated colors on a west wall absorb more heat and show fading sooner, so on the most exposed elevations we may suggest a slightly lighter shade of your chosen color or a product line with better UV resistance. Each alternative gets its own price in the quote, and the call stays yours.

Around the lakes, the friendliest painting months fall between October and May. From June into September, storms roll through nearly every afternoon, so summer crews begin at dawn and keep one eye on the dew point and the radar. Most Hawthorne houses are finished in three to seven working days on the brush, with washing and dry time added on. Our written workmanship coverage on these exteriors lasts up to 10 years and sits alongside the manufacturer's paint warranty. To plan your next repaint, see our guide to exterior paint lifespan in Florida; the full exterior painting service page has the rest. Prefer to start with cleaning only? Our Hawthorne pressure washing page covers it.

faqs.q: Can you paint my Hawthorne house in the summer?
faqs.a: Yes, though it takes planning. Summer days begin early, the crew lead checks dew point and radar before every coat, and work wraps before the storms build. If your timing is flexible, the October to May months make it easier.

faqs.q: Do you treat mildew before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Mildew is treated during the wash so the new coating bonds to a clean surface instead of sealing growth underneath.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with exterior painting?
faqs.a: Your Hawthorne exterior gets our workmanship guarantee in writing, good for up to 10 years, plus the separate product warranty from the paint company.
